hooks.text: 真人秀限时冲上监狱屋顶争夺自由
hooks.excerpt: The only way to shorten this sentence? Win on “The Last Ticket.” The rules are simple: there is a shuttle on the roof of the prison, and if you can fight your way through hordes of other inmates and reach it in time, you will be given your freedom.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 清版格斗、射击与肉鸽融合的肢解战斗
hooks.excerpt: KIBORG is a hybrid of old-school beat’em ups, shooters, and rogue-likes. The fights are fast, brutal, and deadly. Sever limbs, squash heads, and tear cybernetic cores apart from living foes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 替换身体部件叠加数百强化与数十突变
hooks.excerpt: Replace your body parts with an array of cybernetic implants, enabling a wide variety of playstyles. Experiment with hundreds of power-enhancing augmentations and apply dozens of mutations to create deadly synergies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
